Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

Who can apply for Line Superintendent?

Under Advt 08/2023 - a three-year diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognised institution, and Punjabi up to matric.

How many posts were there?

6 posts in the Department of Power, New and Renewable Energy Sources - General 4, SC (M&B) 1, SC (R&O) 1; 2 were reserved for women.
